references.text: The account of Massah, where the Israelites tested the Lord by quarreling with Moses and doubting God's presence among them due to lack of water.
A warning not to harden your heart as at Meribah and Massah, where your ancestors tempted God and put him to the test.
King Ahaz refused to ask for a sign from the Lord, saying he would not tempt the Lord—a reference to the prohibition against putting God to the test.
Jesus quotes this verse when Satan tempts him to throw himself down from the temple, answering: 'You shall not put the Lord your God to the test.'
Luke's account of Jesus' temptation where he quotes this verse in response to the devil.
Paul warns the Corinthians not to put Christ to the test, as some of the Israelites did in the wilderness and were killed by snakes.
The author of Hebrews quotes Psalm 95 and warns against hardening your heart as on the day of testing in the wilderness.
